title: Promote Floating Island / Skyland Editor

constructionMilestones.deliverable: Audit current Island schemas, runtime modules, registry records, fixtures, wiki terrain/ecology sources, and actual exported examples.
Define the authoritative Island production input/output contract and downstream consumer boundaries.
Add or revise the canonical Island JSON schema and schema-level reference requirements.
Complete migration adapters for older flat, 2.0.0, and early 3.0.0 Island records.
Create representative valid, edge-case, invalid, and downstream-consumer fixtures.
Complete Island production-editor integration through the P0 shared kernel.
Provide deliberate manual editing for every canonical production record and reference.
Reconcile geometry, acreage, water, food, settlement capacity, drift, fracture, resources, ecology, and references.
Add selective randomization and presets without overwriting locks or deliberate edits.
Complete canonical JSON, wiki, Population, Settlement, Ecology, Route, Market, Faction, Crisis, and Encounter exports.
Complete accessibility, mobile layout, and keyboard-operation review.
Add structural, functional, migration, round-trip, reference, and Chromium smoke coverage.
Verify Settlement, Ecology, and Route fixtures consume the exported Island profile.
Update registry status, wiki links, README, deployment notes, and development history.
Pass the complete P1 exit gate before activating P2.

exitCriteria.criterion: Map cells can be deliberately edited rather than only generated
Every site, resource, and hazard has a stable ID and map reference
Derived acreage, population capacity, water, drift, and fracture outputs validate
Profile imports and exports round-trip without data loss
Settlement, ecology, and route fixtures can consume the exported profile

automationPolicy.reason: Do not restore the previously paused workflow that created recurring P1 receipt commits on every push.

nextAction: Complete milestone 1 by producing an evidence-backed audit matrix of the existing Island 3.0.0 production stack and identifying the first unmet production requirement.
